newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at mid-March.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at mid-March.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $29.41 million in the first half of March to $6,290.78 million according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet published on Tuesday.
The reserves rose $90.27 million in the second half of February to $6,261.37 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the central bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they did not change from end of February's $4,280 million.
Net reserves were $4,200 million in mid-February. They stood at $4,015 at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
